text:
maria: FYI noticed a jump in endpoint foo-prod p95 after we lowered variant-A weight in routing canary. p50 from 48->56ms, p95 200->360ms, p99 710->720ms; samples halved.
aj: can you share samplecounts?
maria: 18k -> 9k overall; variant-A used to contribute ~40% of low latencies.
sam: this looks like sampling/provenance effect: tdigest merges can shift percentiles when small, low-latency variants shrink.
jonathan: confirmed the rollout: `routing.v1.foo.variantA.weight=0.1` at 2026-03-22T22:14Z (canary). Also see quota.fallback spikes in logs.
maria: product asked why p95 jumped but p99 barely moved. Need better UX/explanation.
aj: propose small badges: "p95 · 9k samples · merged" with hover showing per-variant p50/p95/p99 and counts.
sam: and a toggle: "merged vs per-variant" so users can see raw percentiles per variant.
jonathan: infra: add `expand=variants` to metrics API so console requests drilldowns only when needed.
maria: also tag samples with `quota.fallback=true` for filtering; fallback pool was slower.
aj: alert idea: when percentile change >25% and samplecount drops >30%, auto-open a rollout-note linking to policy change.
sam: implementation note: tdigest rollups lack origin tags; we need to augment rollup rows with lightweight origin counters.
console-bot: rollout-service recorded r-2026-03-22-77 at 22:14Z.
aj: action items: UI badge (maria), metrics API expand (sam), sample tagging + filter (jonathan), prototype alert (aj).
maria: I'll mock the badge and a short tooltip explaining how p95 can move while p99 doesn't.
jonathan: sounds good. we'll add a regression test in telemetry to simulate weight shifts.
sam: +1. That should reduce product noise.
